title: Parameterize a record and its methods
summary: Use a type parameter for both fields, return moved values without cloning and instantiate the same definition for unrelated concrete types.

record.clue: Keyword defining the two-field generic record

implementation.clue: Keyword introducing methods parameterized by T

parameter.clue: Type parameter already declared for the implementation and reused as the record’s sole type argument

selfType.clue: Type spelling for the current Pair<T> within its implementation

receiver.clue: Receiver consuming the pair so both fields can move into the tuple

tuple.clue: Tuple return type containing both generic fields in order

separator.clue: Path separator between Pair and its associated new function

equal.clue: Macro checking the tuple returned by the u32 instantiation
